tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check. Verifies the Netlify Personal Access Token via GET /user.

tools.name: deploy-site
tools.description: Deploy a static site (HTML/CSS/JS) from a workspace directory to Netlify and return the public URL. WARNING: every file under `dir` becomes PUBLICLY readable on the internet — never deploy a directory that contains secrets (.env), credentials, or private data. Pass siteId or siteName to deploy to an existing site; omit both to create a new site. Deploying the whole workspace root is refused unless allowWorkspaceRoot is true. Returns { url, deployId, state, siteId }.

dir.description: Directory to deploy, relative to /workspace (e.g. "site" or "build"). Must contain an index.html. Its entire contents become PUBLIC — point it at a build output dir, not the workspace root.

siteId.description: Existing Netlify site id to deploy to. Takes precedence over siteName.

siteName.description: Netlify site name. Deploys to the matching site if it exists, otherwise creates it.

draft.description: If true, create a draft deploy (preview URL) instead of publishing to production. Default false.

allowWorkspaceRoot.description: Safety confirmation. Deploying `dir: "."` (the whole workspace root) is refused by default because the root usually holds private files. Set true only when the user explicitly wants the entire workspace public. Default false.

tools.name: list-sites
tools.description: List the Netlify sites reachable with the configured token. Returns { sites: [{ id, name, url, ssl_url }] }.

tools.name: get-deploy-status
tools.description: Get the current state of a Netlify deploy. Returns { state, url, errorMessage? }.

siteId.description: The Netlify site id the deploy belongs to.
